findings.failure_path: The new positive case stops after successor admission and checks a few receipt fields. It never feeds the resulting review-predecessor history through completion, extraction-state validation, or ledger binding. Those consumers could still reject the newly admitted history or miscount its rounds while this test passes. The unchanged suites cited in self-review are absent from the packet, so their coverage cannot resolve this gap.
findings.smallest_fix: Supply a bounded regression or inspectable existing coverage carrying a real review-predecessor succession through terminal completion and the receipt consumers, asserting cumulative rounds and predecessor bindings.

findings.failure_path: The one-added-concern differential, applied mutations, and exact-candidate complete-lane success are author declarations without supplied commands and observed run output. The packet therefore cannot establish acceptance criteria 3 and 5 or distinguish a green control from a run on a stale or mutated tree.
findings.smallest_fix: Provide supplemental review evidence identifying the exercised candidate, exact lane and heavy-regression commands, observed results, and attributed mutant/control failures. Reconcile self-review with the withdrawn relocation.

findings.failure_path: All five attestations contain only the same base commit and ref. They contain no ordered receipts, predecessor bindings, round arithmetic, or controller identity. findings.smallest_fix: Keep this acceptance pending until closeout, then supply the ordered receipt sequence and its validation under the frozen pre-change controller as supplemental evidence; these records need not enter the candidate they certify.
